prompt: Which ISO 45001 clause requires the organization to continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the OH&S management system to enhance safety performance?
response:
The specific clause that requires an organization to continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the OH&S management system is **Clause 10.3**.

Here is the exact text from the standard:

**ISO 45001:2018, Clause 10.3 Continual improvement**
"The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the OH&S management system to enhance OH&S performance."

This clause is part of **Section 10 (Improvement)**, which follows the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) cycle, with Clause 10.3 representing the final "Act" phase aimed at elevating safety standards.
